prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: birthday invitation background with live website text overlaid separately.
Primary request: refine the supplied cake illustration so it feels like a restrained, human-painted watercolor illustration for a fine stationery card. It currently has too much repetitive detail, heavy outlines and uniformly busy faux paper texture.
Style/medium: traditional watercolor and a little gouache on lightly textured ivory paper; confident economical brushwork, natural variation in marks, soft pigment blooms, imperfect edges and quiet unpainted space. Simplify the frosting into clearly readable, individually varied piped shapes. Use fewer, broader brushstrokes on the cake, matte cherries with subtle highlights, naturally varied candle flames, and delicate broken contours instead of thick dark outlines. Make the cream stand geometrically believable and less ornamental. Replace the uniformly mottled yellow background with pale warm ivory paper and very subtle natural grain; keep only a light loose wash suggesting the tabletop below. This should look like a simple original stationery illustration, with neither glossy rendering nor artificial grunge.
Constraints: preserve the supplied canvas aspect ratio and exact composition, cake location and approximate silhouette/scale, space reserved for copy, pastel pink cake, three striped lit candles, three cherries, cream pedestal, and small burgundy bows attached to the cake. Preserve color relationships but soften the overly saturated yellows. Keep the outer framing ribbon absent. Do not add decorations or objects. No lettering, text, watermark or border. Output only the finished background artwork.
Input image: edit target, square card artwork. Preserve its framing exactly.
